title.narrative: Accessible and Equitable Justice for Women and Youth (J-Way) Project

description.narrative: Attaining gender equality is still a long shot for humanity, in Nigeria, the need for concerted efforts to ensure equity and access to opportunity for women and youths is paramount. The women remain the most vulnerable population in societies, coupled with the fact that they are the closest to the children, makes their plight even more abysmal. Addressing this can be done through deliberate efforts to recompense women from the historical injustice they face from contributing to decision-making and community development. Similarly, the youths who are future leaders have continued to experience limited opportunities in diverse aspects. This has resulted in misuse of youths as tools for destruction and violence rather than their talent being used for the benefit of society. The Accessible and Equitable Justice for Women and Youth (AEJ-WAY) project in Barkin Ladi and Mangu Local Government Areas, Plateau State, which started in April 2024, has become a local thinking effort that contributes to a global action to fight against injustice for women and youth. The Project is aimed at mainstreaming youths and gender issues in public policy, decision-making, and positioning them where they can make positive impacts by changing the current social and environmental issues in their communities and State. In FY2, the project will sustain the efforts of FY1 by building the capacity of women and youths in more sophisticated climate smart agricultural activities. Link the beneficiaries to the market and design a mentorship platform where they can emulate the corporate world and build an enterprise. The intervention also aims to position women and youth at the centre of ensuring that conflict sensitivity and social cohesion continue to flourish in the communities. Also, participate in local politics, mobilise relevant stakeholders in the community, have more engagement with the local government authorities in areas of community development, budget participation, and tracking.
